findings.evidence: Lines 235-238: the proof is `((continuous_finsetProd …).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).mono_set (orderedRegion_subset_Icc T n t)` — nothing after `continuous_finsetProd` uses the product structure, so the generalization is free.
findings.fix: State the general lemma `lemma Continuous.integrableOn_orderedRegion (hg : Continuous g) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : IntegrableOn g (orderedRegion T n t)` with the same proof, and either derive the product case from it or drop `integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod` and call it with `continuous_finsetProd _ fun i _ => hf.comp (continuous_apply i)`.
findings.issue: `setIntegral_orderedRegion_succ` (line 245) is public for an arbitrary integrand `g`, but the only integrability lemma shipped is `integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod`, specialized to `∏ i, f (p i)`. Any consumer applying the Fubini theorem to another continuous integrand (e.g. the NuclearMedium opacity expansion, which the roadmap lists as a user of this module) must reprove boundedness.

findings.evidence: grep of the file for `orderedRegion` shows only `orderedRegion_zero` (line 194), `cons_mem_orderedRegion_iff`, `measurableSet_orderedRegion`, `orderedRegion_subset_Icc`, `integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod` and the three `t ≤ T` theorems; no emptiness lemma exists.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma orderedRegion_eq_empty {T t : ℝ} (h : T ≤ t) (n : ℕ) : orderedRegion T (n + 1) t = ∅` (immediate from `mem_orderedRegion` and `Set.Ioo_eq_empty`), which also pins down `volume` and the set integral in the complementary case.
findings.issue: The degenerate regime of `orderedRegion` has no lemma. `orderedRegion_zero` covers `n = 0`, but the claim that the region is empty for `T ≤ t` and `n ≥ 1` — which the module docstring (lines 79-80) and the `volume_orderedRegion` docstring use to justify the `t ≤ T` hypothesis on all four public theorems — is stated only in prose, so a consumer evaluating the region integral or its volume outside `t ≤ T` gets nothing from this API.

summary: The orderedRegion surface is minimal, correctly annotated, and carries no compatibility artifacts; the two prior findings are fixed. Two API gaps remain: the only integrability lemma offered for the general-`g` Fubini theorem is specialized to the product integrand, and the degenerate `T ≤ t` case asserted in the docstrings has no lemma.
